Pause-Gamesflow

Pause-Games/flow/flow.types

Shared Flow types: the element tree, flexbox style, component props, screen definitions and the navigation API.

  • GitHub: Pause-Games/flow — pinned to 1.0.0
    1. Pick a release from Pause-Games/flow releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:
